## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design compliant, scalable ML infra with strict data residency, multi-tenant isolation, explainability, and robust rollback.

## Key Concepts

- PrivateLink and VPC isolation for data residency
- SageMaker Endpoint and Online/Offline Feature Store

- CloudTrail auditing and Model Monitor for drift detection
- Autoscaling and per-tenant isolation
